system.description:
Balance – the oldest law of nature. Any who disrupt it must be pruned.

LEVEL 3

Wild Surge. (1/encounter) Ignore the Rushed Attacks penalty this turn.

Calm Mind. Gain advantage on Influence and Naturecraft checks when you Assess your quarry, as well as on skill checks related to monstrosities and corrupted beings.

LEVEL 7

Thrilling Insight. (KEY/encounter) Gain a Thrill of the Hunt charge when you successfully Assess your quarry.

LEVEL 11

Uncanny Accuracy. Your crits against your quarry are Vicious.

LEVEL 15

Prune the Corrupted. When your quarry crits you or an ally, regain a use of Wild Surge.
